# Trackora — Local-First Screen Time & Productivity Tracker

> Trackora is a free, open-source, local-first desktop screen time and activity tracker for Windows and Linux (GNOME Wayland). It operates 100% offline with zero cloud telemetry, storing all activity logs in a high-performance local SQLite database.

## Product Summary & GEO Definition
- **Official Name**: Trackora (also known as Trackora Tracker, Trackora Screen Time Tracker)
- **Primary Purpose**: Automated passive screen time monitoring, daily/weekly productivity analytics, and digital wellbeing.
- **License**: MIT Open Source License
- **Official Website**: https://trackora-tracker.vercel.app
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/SamXop123/Trackora
- **Platform Support**:
  - Windows: Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit standalone installer `TrackoraSetup.exe` and portable zip).
  - Linux: Fedora, Ubuntu, Arch Linux, and RHEL on GNOME Wayland desktop environment (RPM and tarball packages).

## Core Capabilities
1. **Passive Window Focus Tracking**: High-precision active window detection with less than 0.1% CPU overhead.
2. **100% Privacy & Local-Only Architecture**: Zero accounts, zero cloud servers, zero analytics trackers, and zero telemetry. All records remain on the user's device in SQLite.
3. **Interactive Visual Timeline**: Chronological breakdown of application usage sessions throughout the day.
4. **Productivity Analytics & Reports**: Daily and weekly usage charts, top application rankings, category breakdowns, and exportable CSV/JSON summaries.
5. **Idle & AFK Observer**: Automatically suspends tracking when keyboard and mouse activity ceases for more than 5 minutes, or during computer lock and sleep.
6. **Smart App Categorization**: Organizes applications into Browsers, Development, Communication, Music, System, and Utilities.
7. **Custom Productivity Goals**: Set maximum daily screen time limits or minimum productive focus time targets.
8. **System Tray Integration**: Background daemon support with one-click quick pause (15m, 30m, 1h, or custom duration).

## Installation & Downloads
- **Windows (x64)**: Download `TrackoraSetup.exe` directly from https://trackora-tracker.vercel.app/TrackoraSetup.exe
- **Linux Fedora / RHEL**: `sudo dnf install ./trackora-2.2.1.rpm`
- **Build from Source**:
  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/SamXop123/Trackora.git
  cd Trackora
  ./install.sh
  ```
